message.text:
The scheduler package contains a documentation example of a daily-cleanup job at 2 AM. It is never imported or started by the server.

No database-cleanup job is registered. The only production background job is s3presign, running every 12 hours via ticker. A stale-session-cleanup entry in the scheduler README may be documentation-only.

message.text: No nightly database-cleanup job exists in the repository. Only documentation examples were found.

r03.
No nightly database-cleanup job is scheduled. `internal/scheduler` is a library only—never constructed or started from `cmd/` or `server/`. Docs/examples mention `"0 2 * * *"` (`internal/scheduler/doc.go`) and `"0 3 * * *"` stale-session cleanup (`internal/scheduler/README.md`); those are not registered. The only production background runner is S3 presign on a 12-hour ticker (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`).
